newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 95,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 95,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts Friday were 95,000 head, compared with 109,000 a week ago and 93,000 a year ago. Saturday's estimate was 10,000 head, compared with 17,000 a week ago and year ago.
Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts $1.00-$1.50 per cwt lower than midsession Thursday. Trade was slow for light demand and offerings.
Sows: mostly steady with some weakness on 500 up.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts 1.00 lower. Sows steady to 2.00 lower. Receipts this week 517,000 last week 508,000, last year 496,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending June 7, 1997 256.1 lbs compared to 255.1 lbs previous week 248.8 lbs last year.
